values.description: Simulates an intermittently failing downstream service

properties.name: chaos.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for HavocFlow chaos injection. Must be true for any chaos to be applied. NEVER set to true in production.

properties.name: chaos.dry-run
properties.description: When true, the chaos engine logs what it would do but does not actually inject latency or exceptions.

properties.name: chaos.default-failure-rate
properties.description: Default failure probability (0.0–1.0) applied when @InjectChaos does not specify failureRate.

properties.name: chaos.scenarios
properties.description: Named chaos scenarios. Reference them with @InjectChaos(scenario = "name").

properties.name: chaos.max-latency-millis
properties.description: Hard upper bound on injected latency in milliseconds. Prevents thread-pool starvation from misconfigured values. Default: 30000 (30s).

properties.name: chaos.forbidden-profiles
properties.description: Comma-separated Spring profile names where chaos.enabled=true is forbidden. Throws IllegalStateException on startup if violated.

properties.name: chaos.allowed-exception-classes
properties.description: Optional allowlist of fully-qualified exception class names permitted for injection. When empty, any Throwable subclass is accepted.

properties.name: chaos.log-gremlins
properties.description: When true, logs a WARN message each time chaos is injected, including the method name and decision details.

properties.name: chaos.event-store-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of chaos injection events stored in the in-memory ring buffer. Oldest events are discarded when capacity is exceeded.

properties.name: chaos.http-fault.enabled
properties.description: Enable HTTP-layer fault injection via a servlet filter. Injects HTTP error responses and/or latency on matching requests.

properties.name: chaos.http-fault.failure-rate
properties.description: Probability (0.0–1.0) that a matching HTTP request receives a fault response.

properties.name: chaos.http-fault.http-status
properties.description: HTTP status code returned when a fault is injected by the HTTP fault filter.

properties.name: chaos.http-fault.latency
properties.description: Latency to inject before fault HTTP responses. Supports fixed values (e.g. '200ms', '1s') and jitter ranges (e.g. '100ms-500ms').

properties.name: chaos.http-fault.path-patterns
properties.description: List of regex patterns for request URIs that the HTTP fault filter applies to. An empty list matches all paths.

properties.name: chaos.gremlins.cpu-threads
properties.description: Number of background threads to spin when a CPU stress gremlin fires. Capped at available processors.

properties.name: chaos.gremlins.cpu-duration-millis
properties.description: Duration in milliseconds for which CPU stress threads run. Hard-capped at 5000 ms.

properties.name: chaos.gremlins.memory-allocation-mb
properties.description: Megabytes of heap to allocate during a memory pressure gremlin. Hard-capped at 25% of JVM max heap.

properties.name: chaos.gremlins.connection-count
properties.description: Number of JDBC connections to borrow and hold during a connection pool exhaustion gremlin.

properties.name: chaos.gremlins.connection-hold-millis
properties.description: Duration in milliseconds to hold borrowed connections. Capped at min(5000, chaos.max-latency-millis). Connections are always released in a finally block.
